chunks.text:
Initial Screening for Drugs or Poisons
After an isolated sample has been collected by a forensic toxicologist, it is then screened to identify any drugs or poisons such as alcohol, marijuana, or arsenic.
Common toxicology screening techniques include:
colour testing,
microcrystalline testing,
immunoassay testing, and
gas chromatography.
